product_metadata.title: SONGMICS 8 Tiers Utility Steel Shoe Rack Shoe Storage Organizer Cabinet Tower Stackable Shelves Holds 40 Pairs Of Shoes - 39.4 x 11 x 56.3 Inches Grey ULSR08G
features: STURDAY AND DURABLE:Constructed from high quality and durable Metal Tube, plastic connectors and Non-woven Fabric, this large capacity shoe rack will last long
STORE UP TO 40 PAIR OF SHOES: Durable 8 tiers Shoe Rack can Store up to 40 pairs of shoes to keep your entryway, closet or mudroom away from mess
SPACE SAVING SHOE ORGANIZER: With size of 39 3/8"L x 11 1/8"W x 56 1/4"H (100 x 28 x 143cm), this shoe rack is suitable for men, women and kids’ shoes, Height between layers: 6 3/4" (17cm)

EASY TO ASSEMBLE & FUN OF DIY: The unit snaps together for easy assemble, you can set it up quickly with no tools,and set it up into different number of layers like 5-tier or 3-tier, which can be put into various places
OPTIONAL FUNCTIONALITY: You can remove a layer to fit not only boots, heels, but also fit purses or other larger stuffs
